an3.72:1.1: [kosambinidānaṃ] ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an3.72:1.2: atha kho aññataro ājīvakasāvako gahapati yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so ājīvakasāvako gahapati āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca :
an3.72:2.1: kesaṃ no bhante ānanda, dhammo svākkhāto,
an3.72:2.4: tena hi gahapati, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi.
an3.72:2.6: ye rāgassa pahāṇāya dhammaṃ desenti, dosassa pahāṇāya dhammaṃ desenti, mohassa pahāṇāya dhammaṃ desenti, tesaṃ dhammo svākkhāto no vā,
an3.72:2.8: ye bhante, rāgassa pahāṇāya dhammaṃ desenti, dosassa …pe… mohassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desenti, tesaṃ dhammo svākkhāto.
an3.72:3.2: ye rāgassa pahāṇāya paṭipannā, dosassa …pe… mohassa pahāṇāya paṭipannā, te loke supaṭipannā no vā
an3.72:3.4: ye bhante, rāgassa pahāṇāya paṭipannā, dosassa …pe… mohassa pahāṇāya paṭipannā, te loke supaṭipannā.
an3.72:4.2: yesaṃ rāgo pahīṇo ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, yesaṃ doso pahīṇo …pe… yesaṃ moho pahīṇo ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, te loke sugatā, no vā
an3.72:4.4: yesaṃ bhante, rāgo pahīṇo ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, yesaṃ doso pahīṇo …pe… yesaṃ moho pahīṇo ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, te loke sugatā.
an3.72:5.1: iti kho gahapati, tayā vetaṃ vyākataṃ
an3.72:5.2: ye bhante, rāgassa pahāṇāya dhammaṃ desenti, dosassa …pe… mohassa pahāṇāya dhammaṃ desenti, tesaṃ dhammo svākkhātoti.
an3.72:5.4: ye bhante, rāgassa pahāṇāya paṭipannā, dosassa …pe… mohassa pahāṇāya paṭipannā, te loke supaṭipannāti.
an3.72:5.6: yesaṃ bhante, rāgo pahīṇo ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, yesaṃ doso pahīṇo …pe… moho pahīṇo ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, te loke sugatāti.
an3.72:6.2: na ceva nāma sadhammukkaṃsanā bhavissati, na ca paradhammāpasādanā,
an3.72:6.3: āyataneva dhammadesanā, attho ca vutto, attā ca anupanīto.
an3.72:6.4: tumhe bhante ānanda, rāgassa pahāṇāya dhammaṃ desetha, dosassa pahāṇāya dhammaṃ desetha, mohassa pahāṇāya dhammaṃ desetha.
an3.72:6.6: tumhe bhante ānanda, rāgassa pahāṇāya paṭipannā, dosassa …pe… mohassa pahāṇāya paṭipannā.
an3.72:6.8: tumhākaṃ bhante ānanda, rāgo pahīṇo ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, tumhākaṃ doso …pe… tumhākaṃ moho pahīṇo ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
an3.72:7.2: seyyathāpi bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti. evamevaṃ ayyena ānandena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an3.72:7.3: esāhaṃ bhante ānanda, taṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammaṃ ca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ca.
an3.72:7.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ ayyo ānando dhāretu, ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
